channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 24
item.description:
15 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Fixed the repair bench so it works correctly when repairing structures and items.
  • Random skin crafting now includes the default skin as a possible outcome.
  • Suspension, steering, and grip have been tweaked; burnout/launch feature removed; rear wheels now lock visually during a handbrake.
  • Passenger‑held weapons in the attack helicopter now have aim sway that scales with movement speed.

Crafting & Items

  • Fixed the repair bench so it works correctly when repairing structures and items.
  • Random skin crafting now includes the default skin as a possible outcome.

Vehicles

  • Suspension, steering, and grip have been tweaked; burnout/launch feature removed; rear wheels now lock visually during a handbrake.
  • Passenger‑held weapons in the attack helicopter now have aim sway that scales with movement speed.

NPC & Animals

  • Livestock now have a water need and will drink from nearby containers, rivers, or lakes.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 23
item.description:

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 22
item.description:
11 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Fixed heavy scientists getting stuck after being dropped by the helicopter on certain seeds (small oilrig).

Deployable Physics & Collisions

  • Fixed mismatched colliders and off‑center gib origins for multiple deployables (io.table, HotAirBalloon armor, sculpture.ice, mannequin, chandelier, component.box.charcoal.large, HotAirBalloon basket, refinery, windmill, wooden box, fireplace, lift shaft top, tool cupboard, cannon, component box wood), eliminating clipping and improving break‑apart physics.
  • Added gib pieces to the Frankenstein table so it now breaks apart correctly when destroyed.

Grenade Stack Sizes

  • Reduced stack sizes for F1 grenades, Bee grenades, Flashbangs, and Molotovs from 5 to 3.
